The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-stack-started-generating-3|The Payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-2. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online without conventional payment platforms is essential for creators in many regions. These platforms often charge high fees and impose restrictions that limit creator autonomy. This infrastructure focuses on a decentralized approach, providing the tools needed to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies efficiently. By leveraging automated delivery and cost-effective payment processing, you can maximize your earnings while retaining full control over your digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several key components that work together to provide a seamless selling experience. Using cloud-based hosting solutions like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, you can deploy your store without upfront costs. Additionally, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, while NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency payments at a low fee of just 0.5%. This integrated setup ensures that you have a responsive, efficient, and secure online store.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in countries where traditional payment platforms are either unavailable or excessively costly. If you're a musician, producer, or content creator in regions like Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or Venezuela, you can benefit from this stack. By empowering creators with direct access to payment processing and automated delivery, the infrastructure promotes financial sovereignty and independence, crucial for thriving in a digital economy.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, far lower than traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this architecture include cloud hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing tools. By utilizing services like Supabase for order management and Google Drive for file hosting, you can create a fully operational store. Furthermore, NOWPayments ensures that you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility in pricing and payment options, which is vital for reaching a global audience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting solution like Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, and ensure your product files are accessible via Google Drive. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides everything you need to build and scale your digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a decentralized payment solution like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, minimizing fees and maximizing control over your sales. By utilizing cloud hosting and automated logic, you can set up a fully operational digital store.
You retain full ownership of your digital assets and sales data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell music online without using PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell music online by utilizing a decentralized payment processor like NOWPayments, which accepts Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies. This approach eliminates dependency on traditional payment platforms and allows you to keep more of your earnings.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments compared to Gumroad?

NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% fee. For example, with 100 sales of a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921 in your pocket, enhancing your profitability.
What tools do I need to set up my digital store?

To set up your digital store, you'll need a cloud hosting service, backend processing tools, an order management system, and a payment processor. Using platforms like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments allows you to create a comprehensive and cost-effective solution.
Can I automate product delivery for my digital downloads?

Yes, you can automate product delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools allow you to set up automated processes that deliver files to customers immediately upon payment confirmation.
Is it possible to sell templates and fonts without platform fees?

Absolutely. By using a sovereign commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers while avoiding the high fees associated with traditional platforms. This solution empowers you to keep more of your earnings.
Automated delivery means instant access for your customers upon payment.
